name: Kashish Khera
headline: Architecture Studies · Project Coordination · Client Experience
profile: Final-year Bachelor of Architectural Studies student at UNSW Sydney with over four years of experience across construction project support, real estate administration, tutoring and retail leadership. A client-focused problem solver who learns best through hands-on work, and has supported construction projects from cost estimating through to coordination.
